decision.explanation: All three organizations—Benedictine University, the University of Chicago, and SRI International—are explicitly mentioned in the original sources as entities for which Srini Krishnamurthy worked. D1S8 states he worked as a research assistant at the University of Chicago from 2001–2005. D1S11 confirms his role at Benedictine University from 2005–2015. D2S11 affirms his status as a researcher at SRI International. These are distinct roles at separate institutions and do not conflict with one another. All are valid under the 'other' slot hint and the 'work for' relation.
